notes: §2002:15.58.3 RV1: the position of the argument with the greatest value, compared by simple-condition rules (RV2): numeric algebraically (§2002:8.8.4.1.1.3), alphanumeric with space padding (§2002:8.8.4.1.1.6.1), national likewise. Unique-extreme legs: NUM, NEG (signed), SCALE (1.25 / 1.30|1.24 / packed 1.299), ONE (single argument = 1), NATNUM, ALNUM, MIX, NAT each give the position written in the .out (NUM=002 NEG=002 SCALE=002 ONE=001 NATNUM=002 ALNUM=003 MIX=002 NAT=002). Run at --std 2002 with the pinned build of dc1f2dcce8: output equals the derived golden.
